Entwarnung.es: señal de fin de alarma, aviso de calma (die)

bloques.titulo: The chronological structure in journalistic language
texto: Short news (**Kurznachrichten**) usually starts by reporting the main event in **Präteritum** (the time par excellence of the German-written media) or in **Perfekt**.
To detail the causes, background or facts that triggered the situation, journalists systematically use **Plusquamperfekt**:
* * Die Feuerwehr löschte den Brand im Stadtzentrum. Zuvor hatten Anwohner dichten Rauch bemerkt * * (The fire was put out in the city center. Previously, the neighbors had noticed a dense smoke).
Connectors such as **nachdem**, **zuvor** (previously) and **davor** (before that) help guide the reader along the time line without confusion.

filas: Zuvor war ein schwerer Unfall passiert.
Nachdem der Regen aufgehört hatte, öffnete der Park.

frases.de: Gestern Abend kam es zu einem großen Polizeieinsatz am Hauptbahnhof.
frases.es: Ayer por la tarde se produjo un gran despliegue policial en la estación central.
frases.en: There was a large police deployment at the central station yesterday afternoon.

frases.de: Ein aufmerksamer Fahrgast hatte einen verdächtigen Koffer auf dem Bahnsteig entdeckt.
frases.es: Un pasajero atento había descubierto una maleta sospechosa en el andén.
frases.en: An attentive passenger had discovered a suspicious suitcase on the platform.

frases.de: Die Beamten sperrten den Bereich, nachdem sie die Reisenden gewarnt hatten.
frases.es: Los agentes acordonaron la zona después de haber advertido a los viajeros.
frases.en: The agents cordoned the area after warning the passengers.
analisis: the agents have cordoned the area

frases.de: Kurz darauf gab die Polizei Entwarnung, weil ein Tourist sein Gepäck vergessen hatte.
frases.es: Poco después la policía dio la señal de calma, porque un turista se había olvidado su equipaje.
frases.en: Soon after, the police gave the calm signal, because a tourist had forgotten his luggage.
analisis: The police gave the sign of calm

bloques.pregunta: What verbal time is used in the news for antecedent: «Ein Fahrgast hatte einen Koffer entdeckt»?

opciones.explicacion: It points to the previous event that led to the subsequent intervention of the police.
The present expresses the present, not a historical background of the news.
The future indicates a coming fact, not what triggered the event.

bloques.pregunta: According to the news, why did the agents arrange the area?

opciones.texto: Because a passenger had found a suspicious suitcase.
opciones.explicacion: It was the previous reported in Plusquamperfekt.

opciones.texto: Because there was a big fire on the tracks.
opciones.explicacion: The text does not mention any fire, but an abandoned luggage.

opciones.texto: Because the train had been delayed for several hours.
opciones.explicacion: The reason for the intervention was the suspect package.

bloques.frase: Die Beamten handelten schnell, nachdem sie den Koffer gesehen ___ .

opciones.explicacion: «gesehen hatten» is Plusquamperfekt in the «nachdem» clause.
«haben» is present; after the Präteritum «handelten» the correlation requires Plusquamperfekt.
«hatte» is singular; the subject is plural («sie», referring to agents).

bloques.frase: Die Polizei gab Entwarnung, weil ein Tourist seinen Koffer vergessen ___ .

opciones.explicacion: With «vergessen» (transient verb of action with haren) the Plusquamperfekt uses «hatte».
«vergessen» forms the times composed with «haben», not «sein».
Perfekt is present, not the Plusquamperfekt required for the previous motive.

bloques.pregunta: What does this phrase in the newsletter mean?
bloques.frase: Kurz darauf gab die Polizei Entwarnung.

opciones.texto: Soon after, the police gave the signal of calm and end of alarm.
opciones.explicacion: «Entwarnung geben» means to report that the danger has passed.

opciones.texto: Shortly after, the police declared a state of maximum emergency.
opciones.explicacion: «Entwarnung» is the alarm stop, not an emergency statement.

opciones.texto: The police arrested the owner of the luggage immediately.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase reports the cancellation of the alarm after checking it was an oblivion.

bloques.frase: Zuvor ___ die Polizei alle Reisenden gewarnt.

opciones.explicacion: «hatte gewarnt» is the form of Plusquamperfekt with the collective singular subject «die Polizei».
«warnen» rules accusative and forms its times composed with «haben».
«haben» is plural; «die Polizei» is grammatically singular.

bloques.explicacion: Präteritum of the verb sperren in journalistic narration.

intro: In press articles and newsletters, it is essential to chronologically order events by combining Präteritum and Plusquamperfekt.
